original_title: 007 First Light Gets Free Trial For Select PlayStation Plus Subscribers

en.title: 007 First Light Offers 1-Hour PS Plus Trial Ahead of Holiday Season
en.summary: PlayStation Plus Premium subscribers can now get a free taste of the critically acclaimed **007 First Light** with a one-hour trial. This offer comes as the game, a major hit of 2026, sees significant discounts, hinting at IO Interactive's strategy to attract new players.
en.body:
For those who haven't yet experienced the thrill of **007 First Light**, IO Interactive and PlayStation are offering a compelling opportunity. Select PlayStation Plus subscribers, specifically those with Premium or Deluxe tiers, can now download and play a one-hour trial of the acclaimed 2026 title. This initiative aims to introduce more players to the latest iteration of the beloved spy franchise, especially as the holiday season approaches and the game is already seeing attractive discounts.

The trial allows players to dive into the game's prologue and some of Bond's early training sequences. These segments are designed to be not only engaging but also inventive, serving as an excellent introduction to the game's core mechanics, narrative, and IO Interactive's distinct vision for James Bond. It’s a perfect way to gauge the feel of the gameplay and the depth of the story before committing to a purchase.

## A Hit Worth Experiencing

Released in May 2026, **007 First Light** has quickly become one of the year's standout titles. It has garnered widespread critical praise, with IGN awarding it a near-perfect 9 out of 10. Reviewers lauded the game for its intelligent and faithful evolution of the Bond formula, expertly blending action and stealth with the signature gadgets, guns, and charm expected of the iconic spy. As of August 2026, the game had already sold over 4 million copies, a testament to its broad appeal and successful execution by IO Interactive.

One excerpt from IGN's review highlighted the developer's dedication: "Demonstrably obsessed with bringing the Bond fantasy to life in a way no game has ever managed before, developer IO Interactive has found a highly successful home for the more curated action-stealth formula of 2012’s **Hitman: Absolution**." The review further praised the game's pacing and its ability to feel fresh yet reverent, avoiding parody while delivering the quintessential Bond experience. IO Interactive has also supported the game post-launch with free updates, encouraging players to return and explore its world.

## Your Next Mission Awaits

This free trial is a significant boon for PlayStation Plus Premium and Deluxe subscribers, offering a risk-free way to experience a game that has resonated so strongly with both critics and players alike. It’s a clear indicator of the game's enduring popularity and IO Interactive’s confidence in its product, especially with potential end-of-year awards on the horizon. The 40% discount, bringing the game down to around $42 for trial participants, further sweetens the deal for those enticed by their hour-long excursion into Bond's world.

## What's Next

With the holiday season in full swing and the **007 First Light** trial available, IO Interactive is clearly looking to capitalize on the game's momentum. Players who enjoy the trial can look forward to a substantial discount, making it an opportune time to secure this highly-rated title and continue their espionage adventures.

content_raw: Select PlayStation Plus subscribers can try 007 First Light for free via a new trial. 007 First Light is one of the biggest games of 2026, but you'd be forgiven for having missed it. It's been a busy year filled with a wide variety of awesome things to play. With the holiday season on the horizon, the game has already started to receive some sizable discounts , so IO Interactive is warming up potential new fans. If you have PlayStation Plus Premium or Deluxe, you can try a 1-hour trial of 007 First Light. This will allow you to play the game's prologue and some of Bond's training sections, which are actually quite fun and inventive for a video game tutorial. It's a great way to come to grips not only with how the game feels to play, but also the story and IO Interactive's take on Bond. If you like it, you can buy the game for 40% off, which brings it down to about $42. 007 First Light is one of the most well-reviewed games of 2026, with IGN giving it a 9 out of 10 and praising it for being a smart yet faithful evolution of the beloved spy franchise. "Demonstrably obsessed with bringing the Bond fantasy to life in a way no game has ever managed before, developer IO Interactive has found a highly successful home for the more curated action-stealth formula of 2012’s Hitman: Absolution," reads an excerpt from our review. "Patiently paced, First Light is brimming with Bond’s trinity of gadgets, guns, and girls in a way that feels fresh but reverent, and never like parody." 007 First Light has sold over 4 million copies as of August 2026 and will presumably rack up a few more copies sold throughout the holiday season, especially if it scores some end-of-year awards. IO Interactive has also released some free post-launch updates for the game to encourage players to revisit it and is planning to drop a new story DLC before the end of the year. Next year, Nintendo Switch 2 fans will also have the opportunity to play the game when it is ported over to the console in March.
